# aidial_application_type_schema (Data Source)

Looks up an existing API-managed DIAL Core application type schema without managing it. Schemas defined in Core's static configuration are read with `aidial_file_application_type_schema`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aidial_application_type_schema" "quick" {
  bucket = "platform"
  path   = "quick"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) DIAL bucket. Must be "platform".
- `path` (String) Application type schema path inside the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `schema` (String) The application type schema as a JSON object string.
- `schema_id` (String) The `$id` of the schema.
